name: browser-use
headline: Full Stack Skills - AI Development Skills
short_description: Full Stack Skills is a free marketplace for full-stack development skills. It offers a collection of practical AI skills for various platforms. Developers can automate tasks, enhance productivity, and streamline workflows. The skills integrate with tools like Claude, Cursor, and Qoder.
author: partme-ai

sections.overview:
Full Stack Skills is a comprehensive directory and navigation hub for AI coding agents, featuring 454+ professionally-maintained skills organized into 42 independently-installable packages. The collection spans frontend frameworks (Vue, React, Angular, Svelte), backend systems (Spring, Node.js, Python, Go, Java), cross-platform development (Tauri, Flutter, Electron), and DevOps tooling. Rather than loading all skills at once—which would exceed token limits—developers use `npx skills add` to install only the packages they need, keeping context usage minimal while maintaining deep domain expertise. Each skill package includes professional knowledge, workflows, and reference materials that AI agents can load on-demand for specific development domains.
Install Vue.js or React skills to enhance AI coding for frontend projects
Add Spring Boot or Node.js packages for backend development assistance
Load Tauri skills for cross-platform desktop and mobile app development
Use DDD and design pattern skills for architecture guidance
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/partme-ai/full-stack-skills`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
